rationale: All four Toffoli pairs have unchanged controls between their members, so each can compute a Gidney temporary AND into a fresh clean ancilla (4 T) and uncompute it by X-measurement plus a CZ fix-up (0 T). cx(ancilla, target) at both ends of each pair reproduces the target updates, giving about 16 T versus 56 T naive. The pyzx pass is kept only if it lowers the count further.
